title: RC 电路的网络函数
statement: 正弦电压源 U_s = 10∠0° V（有效值），角频率 ω = 2000 rad/s，R = 1 kΩ，C = 1 µF，输出取电容电压 U_C。
以 U_s 为激励、U_C 为响应，网络函数（network function）H(jω) = U_C / U_s。求 ω = 2000 rad/s 时 |H(jω)|、H(jω) 的相位，以及 U_C 的有效值。

questions.explain: φ = −arctan(ωRC) = −arctan 2 ≈ −63.43°：输出电压滞后于输入电压。

hints: 网络函数 = 响应相量 / 激励相量。用分压公式把 U_C 写成 U_s 的倍数。
H(jω) = 1/(1 + jωRC)，先算出 ωRC 的值，再求模和辐角。
solution: **1. 写网络函数。** 电容阻抗 Z_C = 1/(jωC)，由分压公式：H(jω) = U_C/U_s = Z_C/(R + Z_C) = 1/(1 + jωRC)。
ω 越高 |H| 越小，ω → 0 时 |H| → 1：这是一个低通（low-pass）电路。

en.title: Network function of an RC circuit
statement: A sinusoidal source V_s = 10∠0° V (rms) at ω = 2000 rad/s drives R = 1 kΩ in series with C = 1 µF; the output is the capacitor voltage V_C.
With V_s as the input and V_C as the response, the network function is H(jω) = V_C / V_s. At ω = 2000 rad/s find |H(jω)|, the phase of H(jω) and the rms value of V_C.

questions.explain: φ = −arctan(ωRC) = −arctan 2 ≈ −63.43°: the output lags the input.

hints: A network function is the response phasor divided by the input phasor. Use the voltage-divider rule to write V_C as a multiple of V_s.
H(jω) = 1/(1 + jωRC). Work out ωRC first, then take the magnitude and the angle.
solution: **1. Network function.** The capacitor impedance is Z_C = 1/(jωC); by the voltage divider H(jω) = V_C/V_s = Z_C/(R + Z_C) = 1/(1 + jωRC).
**4. Output voltage.** V_C = H·V_s = 4.472∠−63.43° V, rms value **4.472 V**.
|H| falls as ω rises and tends to 1 as ω → 0: this is a low-pass circuit.
